{{rt|22|Kalos}} }} '''Kangaskhan...Kangascan't''' (Japanese: '''ガルーラ、試す''' ''{{tt|Garura|Kangaskhan}}, Attempt'') is the 554th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the sixth chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|X}} and his friends arrive in [[Santalune City]]. * {{adv|Y}} comes up with a set of rules to make sure that her friends are safe. * X and Trevor attempt to try and figure out the [[Mega Evolution|transformation]] that [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Li'l Kanga]] can use. * The group is approached by [[Viola]], who offers to help them. * When Y accepts Viola's offer, {{adv|Shauna}} runs off in anger because everyone decides to trust her so easily. * [[Celosia]] tricks Shauna into being put under mind control. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Goomy}} * {{p|Inkay}} * {{p|Espurr}} * {{p|Vivillon}} (Meadow Pattern) * {{p|Dedenne}} * {{p|Furfrou}} (Debutante, Pharaoh, Matron, and Dandy Trims) * {{p|Honedge}} * {{p|Aegislash}} (Shield Forme) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|X}} * {{adv|Y}} * {{adv|Trevor}} * {{adv|Tierno}} * {{adv|Shauna}} * [[Viola]] * [[Mable]] (flashback) * [[Aliana]] (flashback) * [[Celosia]] * {{kal|Grace}} (flashback) * Groomer ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Kangaskhan}} ([[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]];
